'''Uris''' assembled a team of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and bankrolled a project to create [[nanogene droid]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voorsbain]]. Uris' delusions of grandeur led him to believe that the technology would allow him to create an army and rule an empire; during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was prepare to unleash the nanogene droids on Voorsbain's population.
